The Digital Marketing Executive plays a key role in strengthening the hotel's digital presence, driving online visibility, and supporting commercial performance across all digital channels. Acting as a Brand Champion, this role is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, monitoring, and optimization of digital marketing initiatives, with a strong focus on driving direct bookings, enhancing digital conversion, and promoting the hotel's Rooms, F&B outlets, Spa, and other revenue-generating experiences.

The Digital Marketing Executive will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing the hotel's digital platforms, ensuring that website content, offers, imagery, and information remain accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand standards. Working closely with the Digital Field Marketing (DFM) team, Revenue Management, and internal stakeholders, this role will actively monitor digital performance, analyze key metrics, track campaign effectiveness, and identify opportunities to improve online visibility, traffic, and conversion.

The role will also support the execution and performance monitoring of paid digital campaigns, including search, display, and social media advertising, while ensuring alignment with the hotel's overall marketing and commercial objectives. The Digital Marketing Executive will work collaboratively with the creative team to develop digital assets, support campaign launches, and ensure consistent brand communication across online channels.

This individual should demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, commercial awareness, and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for digital growth. The ability to manage multiple priorities, interpret performance data, and translate insights into actionable recommendations will be essential to the role.
Maintain and regularly update the hotel's website and digital platforms, ensuring accurate information, promotions, imagery, and brand consistency.
Work closely with the Digital Field Marketing (DFM) team to support digital campaigns, website optimization, and overall online performance.
Monitor the hotel's presence across third-party platforms, including OTAs, ensuring content, imagery, and promotional information remain accurate and up to date.
Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns to drive incremental Rooms, F&B, Spa, and ancillary revenue through paid search, social media advertising, and other online channels.
Track and report on key digital performance indicators, including website traffic, Digital Direct Share, conversion, campaign results, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Prepare monthly digital marketing performance reports, highlighting key results, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Support the management of allocated digital marketing budgets, ensuring campaigns are monitored and spending remains aligned with approved plans.
Work closely with Revenue Management, Reservations, F&B, and Spa teams to ensure digital promotions and campaigns are aligned with business priorities and commercial objectives.
Coordinate with the content creator, graphic designer, and Social Media Coordinator to ensure timely delivery of creative assets required for digital campaigns.
Assist in planning and launching digital promotions, packages, and seasonal campaigns across relevant online platforms.
Support the optimization of the hotel's online visibility, search engine presence, and direct booking opportunities.
Complete relevant administrative tasks, including campaign documentation, invoices, budget tracking, and coordination with external digital partners.
Stay informed about emerging digital marketing trends, platform updates, and opportunities to enhance the hotel's online presence.
Support the Director of Marketing and wider Marketing team with digital marketing initiatives and other related tasks as required.
q: Education: Diploma required; additional education in sales and marketing fields preferred.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
